name: punditclaims
description: Pundit Claims: a source-backed register of AI claims by Gary Marcus and Ed Zitron. Data is YAML and JSON in git; the site is a reader for one release manifest.

scripts.build: astro build && pagefind --site dist && node --no-warnings scripts/check-dist.ts
scripts.build:scale: PC_FIXTURE_SCALE=${PC_FIXTURE_SCALE:-11000} node --no-warnings fixtures/release/build.ts && PC_RELEASE=fixture PC_FIXTURE_SCALE=${PC_FIXTURE_SCALE:-11000} npm run build
